agentStop.bash: python3 scripts/eden-hook.py --tool copilot || python scripts/eden-hook.py --tool copilot
agentStop.powershell: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); foreach ($c in @('python3', 'python', 'py')) { $a = @(); if ($c -eq 'py') { $a = @('-3') }; if (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & $c @a -c 'import sys' 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $in | & $c @a scripts/eden-hook.py --tool copilot; exit 0 } } }; '{}'
